quality_check.description: A single tall vertical ink-wash style reference sheet on warm cream paper, composed of abstract geometric swatches, brush tests, contour studies, hatching, and small compositional motifs. The visible palette uses muted taupe and gray-browns, dusty sage and desaturated teal, soft charcoal, restrained ochre, and selective lipstick-red accents. The sheet shows lightly toothy paper texture, watercolor-like pooling, dry-brush variation, imperfect charcoal contours, and hand-drawn hatching. No characters, logos, labels, or photorealistic elements are visible.
violations: The canvas is approximately 1143 by 2048, which is very close to but not exactly a 9:16 aspect ratio.

Several grouped geometric arrangements read somewhat like miniature composition or object-layout studies rather than strictly isolated texture and palette swatches, though the overall deliverable still functions as a style reference sheet.
